findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: map_workflow · Private data: start_app_signup, request_agent_scan · Public sink: list_services, map_workflow, create_order, start_app_signup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: map_workflow · Private data: start_app_signup, request_agent_scan · Public sink: list_services, map_workflow, create_order, start_app_signup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
